name: spectral_se_audit
status: implementation candidate; seeds LOCKED; no run authorized
builds_on: S1 v0.2 observable/kernel; S1 method/scope decision (PR #54) option 2
seed_rule: np.random.SeedSequence([seed_base, 0, 0, i_tree]) with PCG64, i_tree = 0..191; sources from a child of the same sequence (as S1); batch b = trees 12b..12b+11
controls: S1 v0.2 P0a-P0d unchanged, STOP gates

statistic.R: sample sd (ddof=1) of the 16 batch annealed slopes divided by sqrt(mean over batches of SE_b^2), SE_b = tree-level delta SE within batch
statistic.reference: R^2 ~ F(15, 176) in the linear approximation

outcomes.SE-NOT-REJECTED: R <= R_crit (wording: not rejected at 2^14, never SE validated)
outcomes.BLOCKED: any control STOP, incomplete/uncertified/over-cap tree, non-finite or non-positive batch mean, budget stop; no classification and no automatic rerun
